tools.name: membervault_list_courses
tools.description: Lists the products (courses) in the MemberVault account with their ids. Read-only. Call this first: use one of these ids as course_id in the other tools. The vendor documents no reply fields, so the reply is the vendor's JSON as it is. MemberVault API: GET /api/get_courses.

tools.name: membervault_add_user
tools.description: Adds a user to a course (product). MemberVault finds an existing user with that email and does not create a duplicate, so the call is safe to repeat. Use course_id -1 to add the user with no product access. This changes the account. MemberVault API: GET /api/add_user.

tools.name: membervault_remove_user
tools.description: Removes a user's access to one course (product). The user stays in the MemberVault account, with their other courses and their progress. This changes the account at once. To delete the user entirely, use membervault_delete_user. MemberVault API: GET /api/remove_user.

tools.name: membervault_delete_user
tools.description: IRREVERSIBLE: permanently deletes a user from the MemberVault account, with all of their data, progress and quiz answers. MemberVault cannot undo it. Only call this when the user must be removed completely; to remove course access only, use membervault_remove_user. MemberVault API: GET /api/delete_u

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: membervault_add_user · Private data: membervault_list_courses · Public sink: membervault_add_user · Destructive: membervault_remove_user, membervault_delete_user.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: membervault_add_user · Private data: membervault_list_courses · Public sink: membervault_add_user · Destructive: membervault_remove_user, membervault_delete_user

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
